title: mfmap migration plan, version 1
description: The units a COBOL application is rewritten in, in build order. Endpoints use the same type:name IDs as the entities and relationships in mfmap's store. Open questions are kept with mfmap question, not here. `mfmap check` validates a file against this schema and checks what a schema cannot.

target.description: The language and platform the application is rewritten for.

excluded.description: Programs that are not migrated, such as utilities replaced by the platform or code that no longer runs.

endpoint.description: type:name, such as program:NAME, transaction:ID, screen:MAPSET.MAP, job:NAME, db2:SCHEMA.TABLE, vsam:FILE or dataset:DSN.

evidence.description: file:line, relative to the repository root.

id.description: Also the name of the unit's notes file, units/<id>.md.

wave.description: Build order. A unit depends only on units in earlier waves.

entryPoints.description: How the unit is started: transactions, jobs, APIs or callers outside the unit.

unit.description: ID of a unit in an earlier wave.

on.description: What this unit needs from it: a program it calls or data it reads or writes.

handling.description: How the rewrite handles the dependency, such as calling the other unit's service or sharing a table until both are rewritten.

layout.description: The record layout: a copybook endpoint such as copybook:NAME, or the layout written out.

with.description: The other unit's ID, for an interface between units.

status.description: How far the rewrite has got. todo: not started (the default). building: a thread is implementing it. built: merged, and its acceptance checks pass. verified: its business rules were checked against the cited source and its outputs compared with the current system.

threads.description: Threads that work on the unit, so the Backlog tab can link to them.

task.description: What the thread does, such as build or review.

finished.description: True once the thread has reported back.

description.description: What to compare between the rewrite and the current behavior.

data.description: Sample data in the repository to compare with, if there is any.
